purpose: Blueprints for distinct child landing pages in the Open Source section. Each recipe chooses a visual surface, data contract, motion model and fallback before implementation.

globalContract.runtime: HTML/CSS/vanilla JS by default; use a project-owned runtime only when the landing page needs it.

dataContract.static: A small JSON fixture for screen states, product metrics and labels.
dataContract.live: Optional same-origin endpoint for availability or demo mode; never block the first paint.

avoid: full-page screenshot as the only product explanation
assetPolicy.fallback: Show the key screen as semantic HTML when image or WebGL fails.

motion.full: Pointer parallax on fine pointers and short transform/opacity reveals.
motion.static: Keep screens side by side or stacked with no autoplay movement.

architectures.visualSurface: SVG node graph with readable HTML labels

dataContract.static: Nodes are an array with id, group, input, output and status fields.
dataContract.live: A read-only status snapshot may refresh on demand; do not stream every node by default.

assetPolicy.fallback: Render the same nodes as an ordered list with status text.

motion.full: Transform-only pulses along edges and staged node reveals.
motion.static: Use numbered groups and visible arrows; remove loops and shimmer.

architectures.visualSurface: Semantic KPI cards, tables and progressive charts

dataContract.static: Versioned fixture with units, timestamps, source and null-state fields.
dataContract.live: Fetch same-origin JSON with timeout, stale timestamp and empty/error states; SSE/WebSocket is opt-in.

assetPolicy.fallback: The table and text summary remain the source of truth when chart code is unavailable.

motion.full: Animate chart entry once and highlight changed values with a short transition.
motion.static: Render the final values immediately and announce updates in a polite live region.

architectures.visualSurface: Filmstrip, chapter rail and lazy media facades

dataContract.static: Chapters contain timecode, title, poster, tool and outcome.
dataContract.live: Media metadata may load after intent; never autoplay third-party video on first paint.

assetPolicy.fallback: Poster, transcript and external watch link replace video playback.

motion.full: Scrub-like transform motion and chapter reveal; pause when hidden.
motion.static: Use a still filmstrip and visible chapter navigation.

architectures.visualSurface: Progressive WebGL scene with DOM labels

dataContract.static: Scene manifest lists objects, labels, camera presets and interaction targets.
dataContract.live: Live state is a small overlay or status endpoint; it must not be required to render the scene.

assetPolicy.fallback: Replace the scene with an SVG/HTML map and the same labels.

motion.full: Pointer camera parallax and short camera transitions on fine pointers.
motion.static: Freeze camera, show the DOM map and preserve keyboard navigation.

dataContract.static: Boot with an honest fixture and expose its timestamp/source.
dataContract.live: Same-origin endpoint, timeout, schema validation, stale badge and human-readable error state.

avoid: secret or public credential in HTML
assetPolicy.fallback: Show last-known data as stale and keep the architecture explanation usable.

motion.full: Capped log reveal and status pulse; pause polling when hidden.
motion.static: Use a stable snapshot with explicit last-updated text.

architectures.visualSurface: Token inspector, component states and live controls

dataContract.static: Tokens and component variants are plain JSON; examples declare state and expected behavior.
dataContract.live: Controls update the preview locally; persistence is optional and must be explicit.

assetPolicy.fallback: Print token values and state descriptions beside every visual sample.

motion.full: Small state transitions and view transitions when supported.
motion.static: Switch states instantly and retain focus.

architectures.visualSurface: Long-form narrative with image chapters and evidence blocks

dataContract.static: Content entries include title, dek, image sources, caption, alt and source credit.
dataContract.live: Optional related-project feed loaded after the primary narrative is readable.

assetPolicy.fallback: Text and captions remain complete if every image is unavailable.

motion.full: Scroll-linked chapter emphasis and image reveal within a bounded budget.
motion.static: Use active chapter styling without parallax or scrub.

architectures.visualSurface: Scroll-driven sections with a native DOM reading order

dataContract.static: Content stays in semantic HTML or a versioned catalog; motion never owns the copy.
dataContract.live: Portfolio items can refresh from a same-origin JSON catalog without replacing the page shell.

avoid: large runtime loaded before first paint
assetPolicy.fallback: Native scroll, static hero and accessible carousel controls remain complete.

motion.full: Scroll-linked reveals, bounded kinetic bands and one active media slide.
motion.static: Keep section order, focus states and media controls while removing decorative loops.

architectures.visualSurface: Remote-first rows, focus rings and media shelves

dataContract.static: Shelf fixture includes title, poster, metadata, subtitle and focus order.
dataContract.live: Release metadata may refresh independently from the visual shell.

assetPolicy.fallback: Keyboard arrows and semantic buttons reproduce the remote flow.

motion.full: Focus-scale and shelf movement with a short duration.
motion.static: Use a visible focus ring and no continuous shelf motion.
